title: Tender Dutch Vegetable Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful Dutch-inspired vegetable casserole that's perfect for a weeknight dinner. This comforting dish is made with tender vegetables and a rich, savory sauce.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the Dutch vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced tender vegetables, canned diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, Dutch mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and the sauce has thickened.
